title: Exilado Pacto P’akintirinakaxa
intro: Mä jisk’a ayllun nayrïr urunakapanxa, mä tribux nayrax ch’amanchata utanakan jakasirïna, mä pacto ukarjam phuqhata. Kunawsatix uka pactox aljantatäxän ukhax jan walt’awinakax Quran ukan pankanakapanw ist’asïna. ¿Khitinakas uka jaqenakajj utjäna, ukat kunas utanakapatsa, huertanakapatsa pasäna?
clues: Wali chʼamani cheqanakanwa jakapjjerïta, ukanakajj kʼarinak jan kuna jan waltʼäwin uñjasipjjayätwa.
Uka yatiyirix nanakar jutkäna uka qhipatxa contraw mä amtar puripxta, ukampis uka amtax janiw phuqhaskänti.
Jiwasan palmeras quqanakax Allahan kamachiparjamaw khuchhurata, ukax ch’amapan chimpupawa.
Utanakajat jaqsutäpjjayätwa, janipuniw kuttʼanjjapjjänti, jan istʼasirïpjjatajat mä castigo churañataki.
Quran ukax tantachäw jaljanx jiwasatw arsu, ukat jiwasan sarnaqäwisax mä iwxt’awiwa khitinakatix pactos p’akintapki ukanakataki.

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
